title: Conversation Rotation and Compression Resume Protocol

compressionCount.description: If compressionCount >= 2 in a single active conversation, the main agent must stop and cannot continue in the same window.
compressionCount.resumeRequirement: New window with verified resume capsule

agentLimitHit.description: If agent spawn limit is reached and pending workers cannot be dispatched, main agent must stop.
agentLimitHit.resumeRequirement: New window with verified resume capsule and cleared agent pool

phaseRegression.description: If a closed phase is re-executed or its evidence is regenerated, main agent must stop.
phaseRegression.resumeRequirement: New window; phase regression report required

contextCompressionDuringActiveRun.description: If context compression occurs during an active run, resumeAllowed=false until resume capsule is verified.

resumeCapsule.description: A self-contained JSON artifact created by create-resume-capsule.ps1 at handoff time.

newWindowRequirements.description: Requirements that must pass before a new window agent continues work.
mustNotDo: Continue from memory without reading phase lock
Start DRY18-B before DRY18-A-P2 PASS is recorded
Use a quarantined run as evidence source
Continue in same window if compressionCount >= 2 without new handoff

verifierFailureConditions.description: Conditions that cause verify-resume-capsule.ps1 or verify-new-window-readiness.ps1 to FAIL.

conditions.description: Resume capsule file not found at expected path.
allowedNextPhase in capsule does not match current phase lock.
DRY18-B requested but DRY18-A-P2 PASS is not recorded.
A quarantined run is referenced as evidence source.
compressionCount >= 2 and no new window handoff exists.
A PASS claim lacks an evidence path.

phaseLockUpdateRules.description: Rules for updating current-phase-lock.json during rotation.

forbiddenActionsDuringRotation: Skip resume capsule creation before handoff
